subject: humanities
passage: Origami is the Japanese art of folding paper into shapes such as birds, flowers, and boats. In the traditional form of the art, folders ______ a single square sheet of paper and never cut or glue it. Even very complex models can be made this way.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: In "folders use a single square sheet of paper," the verb "use" is followed directly by its object, "a single square sheet of paper." No punctuation belongs between a verb and its object.
explanation.A: Correct. The verb "use" connects directly to its object with no punctuation.
explanation.B: Incorrect. A comma should not separate a verb from its object.
explanation.C: Incorrect. A colon must follow a complete sentence, and "folders use" is not complete without its object.
explanation.D: Incorrect. A dash should not separate a verb from its object; nothing here is being set off.
